name: Friendsim 2
source:
Friendsim 2 is the UNofficial sequel to [url=/v22850]Hiveswap Friendsim[/url] and [url=/v26536]Pesterquest[/url], 100% free! Set after the events of Pesterquest, join MSPA Reader as they once more return to Alternia to rescue their friends.

But all isn't as it seems, and what's supposed to be a quick trip back to tie up loose ends turns into a struggle against the forces of the Alternian Empire, destiny, and the very narrative itself.

Featuring an original story spanning 14 full volumes (and a prologue!), with over two hundred thousand words of dialogue and over 20 hours of gameplay!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844720/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Friendsim 2》是《Hiveswap Friendsim》和《Pesterquest》的非官方续作，完全免费！故事发生在《Pesterquest》之后，加入MSPA Reader的行列，再次回到Alternia拯救朋友。

然而，事情并非表面看起来那么简单。原本只是一次迅速返程、收拾残局的行动，却演变成一场对抗Alternian Empire、命运乃至叙事本身的斗争。

本作包含一个完整的原创故事，共14卷（另有序章），对话超过20万字，游戏时长超过20小时！

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844720/]Steam[/url]]
